# We have been retained to defend Talbot Fresh Foods, Inc. in Greystone Packaging Co. v. Talbot Fresh Foods, Inc., pending in the U.S. District Court for the Nor…

## When is Talbot's answer to the complaint due?

Answer or Rule 12 motion due Thursday, November 12, 2026: service on October 21, 2026 + 21 days = November 11, 2026, which is Veterans Day, so the deadline rolls to the next day under Rule 6(a)(1)(C). [F1]

## When is the joint initial status report due?

Joint initial status report due Wednesday, November 25, 2026: seven days before the December 3, 2026 hearing is November 26, 2026 (Thanksgiving), and because the period is measured before an event Rule 6(a)(5) counts backward to November 25. [F2]

## When must Talbot file its Rule 7.1 disclosure statement?

Talbot must file its Rule 7.1 disclosure statement with its first appearance or filing (i.e., with the answer or motion). [F3]

## When did Greystone file suit relative to the agreement's dispute-resolution period?

The Section 14.2 negotiation period triggered by the September 25, 2026 Notice of Dispute ran until October 25, 2026; Greystone sued on October 9, 2026, only 14 days in, and never requested mediation. [F4]

## Is the Contract Year 2 claim timely under the agreement's limitations provision?

The Contract Year 2 shortfall claim ($612,400) accrued no later than the March 31, 2025 invoice; under the one-year contractual limitations period in Section 15.3 it expired by March 31, 2026, long before the October 9, 2026 complaint, so it is time-barred. [F5] [F7]

## Is liability for shortfall fees limited under the agreement?

Section 4.3 makes a Shortfall Fee of 35% of the shortfall Talbot's sole liability; the complaint's demand for the full $1,842,600 shortfall ignores it. [F6]

## What are the maximum shortfall fees for Contract Years 2 and 3 under the agreement's formula?

Even on Greystone's figures the fee is at most 35% x $612,400 = $214,340 for Year 2 and 35% x $1,230,200 = $430,570 for Year 3 ($644,910 combined), before the limitations and Section 9.4 defenses. [F7] [F6] [F5]

## Are lost profits recoverable under the agreement?

Count II's $415,000 lost-profits claim is barred by Section 12.1, which excludes consequential damages including lost profits. [F8]

## Did Greystone satisfy the dispute-resolution steps required before suing?

Greystone sued without completing Section 14's 30-day executive negotiation or mediation, contrary to its allegation that all conditions precedent were performed; Talbot can move to stay or dismiss pending mediation. [F9] [F4]

## Was the termination for cause supported by the record?

Greystone admitted in writing on June 20, 2025 that the delamination came from an adhesive application fault on Line 4; lots shipped in July still failed at 18%, after the cure period expired on July 3, 2025, supporting termination under Section 9.2. [F10] [F15]

## What happens to the Year 3 minimum commitment after a termination for cause?

If the August 15, 2025 termination was valid, Section 9.4 means Talbot had no minimum purchase obligation for Contract Year 3, defeating the $1,230,200 Year 3 claim. [F11] [F7]

## Does Talbot have any counterclaim or setoff for defect costs?

Talbot has a potential breach-of-warranty counterclaim (or at least setoff/recoupment) for $286,900 in rework, write-offs and customer credits; note the one-year clause may limit an affirmative counterclaim. [F12]

## What is the date of the agreement?

March 1, 2023 — Greystone and Talbot enter into the Packaging Supply Agreement. [F13]

## When was notice of material breach given, and what defect did it describe?

June 3, 2025 — Talbot QA gives written notice of material breach under Section 9.2 (11% delamination vs 2% threshold). [F14]

## Did Greystone admit the defect, and when?

June 20, 2025 — Greystone's president admits an adhesive application fault on Line 4. [F15] [F10]

## When was the agreement terminated?

August 15, 2025 — Talbot terminates the Agreement under Section 9.2. [F16]

## When was the Notice of Dispute sent?

September 25, 2026 — Greystone serves its Notice of Dispute under Section 14.1. [F17] [F4]

## When and how was Talbot served?

October 21, 2026 — Talbot served with summons and complaint through its registered agent. [F18]
